purpose: Seeds and controlled magnitudes for the server-authority invariant fixtures (B4). Synthetic geometry only: every route is planar metres around a fixed synthetic origin, not a real street or place. No request is sent to any live API.
hypotheses_stated_before_results: H1 Under VERIFIED_STEPS_V1 (rule set 1002) a GPS gap inside the continuity limits (<= 200 m, <= 120 s, <= 12 m/s, no break or pause) yields interpolated units, and those units are pushed as solid ground.
H2 A gap outside any one continuity limit yields no interpolated unit.
H3 With sparse fixes (one every 60-100 s) a measurable share of pushed units lie off the true walked polyline; with fixes every 5-10 s the share is near zero.
H4 The toll's crossed cells never contain an interpolated unit.
H5 Settlement counts a verified session whose server receipt is after the day's close watermark if the settlement has not yet run (reproduced on local PostgreSQL).
